title: Erratic xDrip battery estimates
symptom: After updating the circuit to xBridge2 firmware with battery charge indicator resistors, the battery percentage readings are erratic: overnight it wouldn't charge above 40%, then depleted quickly to 20%, then jumped to 79% when plugged into a 1A charger, charged to 100% quickly, but dropped to 84% immediately after disconnecting.
cause: The xBridge2 battery indication is not a truly accurate measurement of battery capacity; it is only an indication based on battery voltage, not current in/out. The circuit design and off-the-shelf components cannot provide accurate readings.
fix: Use the Adafruit charger's red/green LED to know when charging is complete; do not remove the bridge from charging until the green LED is lit. The indication will then stay at 100% for a fair period. Under the current design, only a rough indication is possible.
evidence_quote: the xBridge2 battery indication is NOT a truly accurate measurement of battery capacity, it is only an indication.based on battery voltage, not a measurement based on current in/out like most mobile phones.
